title: ISC — Escalation Router
description: Triggers when ISC fires a kpi.threshold_breach webhook (critical only). Looks up the responsible team lead from a Google Sheet, creates a Linear (or Jira) issue, and sends an escalation email.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'kpi.threshold_breach'. This Zap only escalates critical breaches — the Filter step in step 2 drops warn events silently.

steps.name: Only continue if severity is critical
steps.note: Warn-level breaches are silently dropped here. Only critical breaches proceed to escalation.

settings.note: Create a Google Sheet named 'TeamLeads' with columns: KPI_Category (A), Name (B), Email (C). Connect your Google account.

settings.title: 🚨 CRITICAL KPI Breach: {{1__data__kpiLabel}}
settings.note: Connect your Linear account. Replace REPLACE_WITH_LINEAR_TEAM_ID. Alternatively, replace this step with 'Jira Software → Create Issue' if your team uses Jira.

settings.subject: 🚨 Escalation: Critical KPI Breach — {{1__data__kpiLabel}}
settings.body:
🚨 Critical KPI Breach — Immediate Action Required

Hi {{3__Name}},

A critical KPI breach has been detected that falls within your area of responsibility.

KPI{{1__data__kpiLabel}}
Current Value{{1__data__value}}
Critical Threshold{{1__data__criticalThreshold}}
Ticket{{4__url}}

→ View in ISC Platform
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap. Choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'kpi.threshold_breach'.
3. Add a Filter step: continue only if severity (Text) Exactly matches 'critical'.
4. Create a Google Sheet named 'TeamLeads' with columns: KPI_Category (A), Name (B), Email (C). Fill in your team leads.
5. Add a 'Google Sheets → Lookup Spreadsheet Row' step. Set lookup column to KPI_Category and value to {{1__data__kpiCategory}}.
6. Add a 'Linear → Create Issue' step (or swap for Jira). Replace REPLACE_WITH_LINEAR_TEAM_ID and connect your Linear account.
7. Add a Gmail action. Set To = {{3__Email}} (team lead's email from the sheet). Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN.
